outcome: Lipid biomarkers (estrogen derivatives, fatty acids, ceramides)
cohort: The study included 65 pregnant women whose plasma was sampled at three time points (6-14, 14-22, and >24 weeks gestation) and 42 postpartum women.
finding: Significant metabolic differences, particularly in lipid metabolism, were identified between pregnant and postpartum women, and distinct metabolic signatures were found across early and late pregnancy stages, with specific lipid molecules acting as potential biomarkers.
